summary: Freightos Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing its financial results for Q1 2026. The filing includes revenue of $7.2 million, a 3% year-over-year increase, and an IFRS loss of $6.5 million. It also provides updates on key performance indicators such as transactions growth (425k, up 15% YoY), carrier count (79, up from 71), and gross booking value growth. The press release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, discusses operational priorities and adjusted EBITDA guidance for 2026. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. Watch for continued market conditions and path to breakeven.
